description:
Meet these odd combination of people - A highschool girl Ahyoon has a severe case of malephobia.  
Jinhui made Ahyoon believe him as a girl. He enjoys being her best friend. Recovered from malephobia, Ahyoon finds her boyfriend Hamin. He can't stand Jinhui stuck with Ahyoon all the time.
